page.content:
7 December 1941 attack that brought the United States into the war.

How Pearl Harbor connects

  • Faction: Imperial Japan — Japan planned and executed the attack on Pearl Harbor.
  • Character: Franklin D. Roosevelt — Pearl Harbor brought Roosevelt's United States fully into the war.
  • Event: Battle of Midway — Midway, six months later, reversed the Pacific carrier war Pearl Harbor opened.

What is Pearl Harbor?

The Japanese strike on the Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor failed to destroy U.S. carriers and instead unified American entry into both Pacific and European wars.

Key threads lead to Imperial Japan, Franklin D. Roosevelt and Battle of Midway.
